scope: Verified final LIBERO-Long implementation; not a claim that all historical PushT/LIBERO policies have identical encoders.

architecture.observationEncoding: Frozen RADIO local patch tokens plus trainable language-FiLM ResNet34 global tokens
architecture.subgoalEncoding: Frozen RADIO local/global features, shared two-layer Perceiver, four latent tokens per goal
architecture.languageEncoding: Frozen DecisionNCE-T embeddings with trainable projection and normalization

actionTrunk.attention: prefix attends to prefix only; actions attend to prefix and action tokens

taskSpecificVariants.inspectedPushTConfig: goal_radio, four encoder/four decoder layers, width 512, three goal frames, eight RADIO latents per frame, byte-GRU language, no proprioception input, 16-step two-dimensional actions

notes: Figure details show the final LIBERO-Long model rather than combining incompatible historical variants.
Planner provides subgoal images and is independent of the policy gradients.
The 91.2% archived result is reported for medoid ensembling of existing checkpoints; the diagram describes the individual policy architecture.
